notes: «جميعا قالوا حدثنا» joins four routes at أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي: one group, the names written once after «جميعا»
«رضي الله عنهما» is a blessing; the Imam after «عن» is kind narrator; the saying's Abu Ja'far is the last link, and Ali in the story is not
